title: Input pointer getter
summary: At VA 0x55b470, thiscall virtual slot +0x20 returns its output pointer after writing two 32-bit words: zeroes when byte +0x246 is nonzero, otherwise the words at +0x23c and +0x240. Reads and writes are ordered. Constructor at 0x55b1dc installs the vtable at 0xa004b0; no direct calls to this address were found. Original disassembly and accepted assembly agree.
test_description: Compare original and recovered return pointers, all object bytes, output and sentinels for every flag byte, varied bit patterns and overlapping output storage; assert expected external output and untouched sentinels.
known_limits: Meaning and units of the two stored words and flag are not established by this getter.
Requires valid writable output and readable object; faulting inputs are not tested.
Virtual callers cannot be uniquely identified from indirect calls alone.
